title: Feasible sub-replicating portfolios for basket options via the block rearrangement algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2611.26119v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We construct sub-replicating portfolios of vanilla options for a basket call when the marginal distributions of the underlying assets are known and their dependence is not. To do so, we reduce the n-asset problem to n two-asset problems of the type solved by Hobson, Laurence, and Wang (2005a), and use the Block Rearrangement Algorithm1 (BRA) to approximate the minimising dependence among the assets. The cash component of the portfolio is computed exactly, so that its price is a valid lower bound, and reassembling the BRA output with the original marginals gives an upper bound computed by quadrature; together they bracket the minimum basket-option price. translated_title: 基于块重排算法的篮子期权可行次复制投资组合
translated_abstract: 当篮子期权标的资产的边际分布已知而其依赖结构未知时，我们为其构建了由普通期权组成的次复制投资组合。为此，我们将n资产问题约化为n个Hobson、Laurence和Wang（2005a）所解决类型的两资产问题，并使用块重排算法（BRA）来近似资产间的最小化依赖结构。投资组合的现金部分被精确计算，因此其价格是一个有效的下界；而将BRA的输出与原始边际分布重新组合，则可通过数值积分得到一个上界；两者共同夹住了最小篮子期权价格。在三个和六个资产的对数正态数值例子中，该区间的相对宽度至多为0.1%，相应的次复制投资组合非常稀疏，每种资产仅使用两个行权价，且所得的界比由通用多边际方法得到的界更为紧凑。
tldr: 该论文将依赖结构未知的n资产篮子期权定价问题分解为n个两资产子问题，并借助块重排算法构建稀疏的普通期权次复制投资组合，从而获得精确下界与数值上界构成的极窄价格区间（相对宽度不超过0.1%）。
en_tdlr: This paper reduces the n-asset basket option pricing problem with unknown dependence structure to n two-asset sub-problems and employs the Block Rearrangement Algorithm to construct sparse sub-replicating portfolios of vanilla options, yielding a tight price bracket (relative width at most 0.1%) between an exact lower bound and a quadrature-based upper bound.
